sources.label: Morphe patch bundles maintained by Kodex.
sources.author: Kodex
patch_list: Repaints the dark theme's background, cards, bars and dialogs to true black for AMOLED screens.
Stops Eyecon from uploading your contacts to its server for caller ID.
Disables Amplitude (including Session Replay screen recording), Singular attribution and Crashlytics crash reporting.
Hides the premium tab from the home bottom bar.
Unlocks every premium feature client-side: removes ads, unlocks themes, premium caller ID and after-call screen, call recording, SMS extras, reverse lookup and ID Plus.
